## Standalone KiCad integration tests

These tests require a live KiCad process, KiCad IPC, Tk/X11 or the native KiCad CLI. They are executed as scripts rather than collected by pytest.

| Script | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [tests/test_eeschema_gui.py](../../tests/test_eeschema_gui.py) | Launches real Eeschema, exercises the block implementation save/edit workflow and verifies saved project state. |
| [tests/test_instance_configuration_gui.py](../../tests/test_instance_configuration_gui.py) | Drives the real Tk instance-configuration dialog and verifies a profile saves its parameter, implementation variant and PCB layout in one schematic IPC transaction. |
| [tests/test_ipc_headless.py](../../tests/test_ipc_headless.py) | Exercises real headless schematic IPC placement, block registration, instance metadata, local-copy creation and synchronization. |
| [tests/test_library_picker_gui.py](../../tests/test_library_picker_gui.py) | Uses real Tk widgets and X11 keyboard events to verify searchable block-picker selection and native placement handoff. |
| [tests/test_pcb_ipc.py](../../tests/test_pcb_ipc.py) | Probes real KiCad PCB IPC primitives against a temporary native board. |
| [tests/test_pcb_layout.py](../../tests/test_pcb_layout.py) | Runs end-to-end stored PCB block-layout application against KiCad and checks generated board output and failure behavior. |
| [tests/test_plugin_registration.py](../../tests/test_plugin_registration.py) | Verifies KiCad discovers the installed schematic IPC plugin action and that managed installation works on supported Python ABIs. |

| python -m compileall -q plugin tests scripts examples | Compiles project Python sources to catch syntax errors. |
| ruff check plugin tests scripts examples | Runs Ruff lint over production, test, script and example code. |

## Collection and maintenance rules

- Add every tests/test_*.py file to exactly one pytest group or to STANDALONE_TESTS; an unlisted or multiply listed module fails CI.
- Pytest-routed modules must define at least one collectable test function or test-class method.
- Standalone tests must define main(), use a __main__ guard and be invoked explicitly by CI.
- The pytest collection hook verifies that every module selected by an invocation produces at least one collected item.
- Regenerate this file after inventory changes with python scripts/test_inventory.py --write-docs.
